children: Annual food inflation in New Zealand stood at 1.9% in August 2026, unchanged from the previous month, which was the softest increase since December 2024.

Prices for meat, poultry, and fish increased by 3.4% (vs 3.2% in July), after marking the slowest rate since at least June 2025 in July, and remained the largest contributor to the annual increase in food prices.
Grocery food prices also accelerated (1.7% vs 1.6% in July), while fruit and vegetable prices fell at a faster rate, declining 1.6%, following a 1.0% drop in July.
Monthly, food prices rose 0.3%, following a 0.1% gain in July and marking the fourth straight month of increase.

title: New Zealand Food Inflation Stays at 19-Month Low
